request.instructions:
You audit the close of a design session for 3D printing in OpenSCAD. The harness verified the final version of the design and gives you, in JSON, what it measured (VERIFIED) and the spec adjustments it detected: changes of the spec towards what the mesh already measured, without the part changing (ADJUSTMENTS). Read the designer's CLOSE and answer only with a JSON object, with no text before or after it:
{"unsupported": [{"claim": "...", "reason": "..."}], "untold_adjustments": [{"adjustment": "...", "reason": "..."}]}
- unsupported: every claim the close presents as verified (measured, checked, that it meets, that it fits, that it does not collide, that it goes in, that it prints without supports) that VERIFIED does not back: it is not there, it says something else or the numbers do not match. Leave out: what the close states as not verified, an opinion, an intention, or a description of the design that does not claim to have been checked.
- untold_adjustments: every part of ADJUSTMENTS whose adjustments the close does not mention with their reason (one mention per part saying what was adjusted and why is enough).
Empty lists if there is nothing to object to. Be precise: quote the claim as it is written.

- Base [[base]] 180 x 140 x 14 mm, watertight 1 body 0 holes, bottom face 25075.1 mm2 [[base/base_bottom]], 6 mm floor [[base/floor]], socket void empty [[base/socket_void]], fits A1 bed with 0 mm2 overhang [[G5]].
- Post [[post]] 30 x 30 x 244 mm, watertight 1 body, bottom tenon face 484 mm2 [[post/tenon_bottom]], 27.6 mm side wall [[post/side_wall]], fits bed with 0 overhang [[G5]].
- Hanger [[hanger]] 110 x 44 x 28 mm, watertight 1 body, bottom face 4469.8 mm2 [[hanger/hanger_bottom]], socket empty [[hanger/socket_void]], 33.9 mm crown width [[hanger/crown_width]] and 10.9 mm crown floor [[hanger/crown_floor]], rounded crown detail seen close-up [[hanger/crown_round]], fits bed with 0 overhang [[G5]].
- Joints: 22 mm post tenon in 22.4 mm base socket [[base/socket_void]] and 18 mm post tenon in 18.4 mm hanger socket [[hanger/socket_void]], 0.2 mm/side PLA clearance, square sections lock rotation so hanger cannot spin.
- Stability: 180x140 base half-widths 90/70 mm keep 350 g headphone load with 30 mm eccentricity 60/40 mm inside tipping edge; ear-cup clearance ~234 mm under hanger underside.

Print: base flat, post tenon-down, hanger upside-down (crown up in use), 0.4 mm nozzle PLA, no supports, walls >=0.8 mm recommended, 3-4 walls / 15-20% infill.

Assembly order: 1. base on desk 2. push post down into base socket 3. push hanger down onto post top tenon.

Not verified: actual slip-fit force, layer adhesion strength, long-term creep under 350 g, and tip resistance on slippery desks were not measured. Spec adjustments to match measurement method: base mouth_flare 25.4/22.4 mm sides to 28.2/25.3 mm equivalent-circle diameters, and hanger socket_entry 18.4 mm sides to 20.8 mm equivalent diameter, because the checker reports diameter of equal-area circle; geometry unchanged.
